about_the_game:
My Bimbo Dream is a kinky visual novel about corruption, power exchange, bimbofication and control.

You play as Randall, a broke art school dropout forced to move back in with his long-time “landlady,” Sue. But everything changes when Sue decides to get breast implants—and suddenly, your deepest fetish is walking around the house in a tight tank top. You’ve always had a thing for her. Now, she’s taking her first step toward becoming your perfect woman.

Can you guide her further down the path—toward your vision of the perfect slut?

A Sexy Cast to Romance and Corrupt:

  • Sue – The sweet “landlady” hiding a wild past.

  • Lucia – Her seductive, dangerously promiscuous best friend.

  • Scarlett – Your ex, not as over you as she claims.

  • Megan – A cute wildcard with lots of potential.

Features & Gameplay

  • Branching paths: Pursue multiple optional kink-driven routes: Harem, Pimp, or NTR. Each with persistent consequences and distinct endings.

  • Choice-driven transformation: Shape Sue’s personality, behavior, and appearance through your actions and decisions.

  • High-quality visuals: Thousands of hand-crafted 3D renders and hundreds of animations.

  • 6–8 hours of gameplay per kink path: Over 18+ hours total if you explore every route.

  • Mini-games: in-game phone with social media, text messages, Photo mode, hidden image hunts, and unlockable galleries.

  • Original soundtrack and immersive sound effects.

What NOT to Expect

  • This is not a sandbox or a 3D open-world game. It's a fully scripted visual novel.

  • You won't be able to customize the characters' body types—this is a curated experience.

  • Not a vanilla romance. Expect kinks, fetishes, and power dynamics.

  • This isn’t just a shallow sex game. It’s a story-rich visual novel written by CHYOA author Sinburn and developed over two years by a passionate team that continues to grow.

None of this would be possible without you, our incredible fans and community. This launch marks a huge step forward, and with your support, we’re already looking ahead to even bigger, bolder projects… starting with My Bimbo Dream: Season 2!
